messages:
marie: Hey folks — planning to pin zetta-4b:v2 into the catalog this week. Need to coordinate staging deploy, smoke checks, and prod pin window. Who can own the staging rollout?
ben: I can take staging rollout tomorrow at 10:30 PT. Will do the canary and smoke.
akira: thx ben. I can be on-call for rollback and tests 10:30–12:00 if anything looks flaky.
matt: quick ask — is the model quantized? any perf diffs we should watch for?
marie: yes matt, this v2 build is int8-quant. Perf looked good locally (10% latency drop), but we need token-quality smoke.
ben: plan for staging: 1) deploy to staging-catalog slot 2) run smoke prompts set `catalog/smokes/zetta-v2` 3) check perf dashboard for p95 and token cost 4) either pin alias -> v2 or rollback.
diane: pinging infra for capacity: @deploy-bot can you reserve a slot for staging tomorrow 10:15 PT?
deploy-bot: reserving slot staging-slot-42 for zetta-4b:v2 at 2024-09-18T10:15:00Z — reservation id rsv-7381. Please confirm. :white_check_mark:
marie: confirmed. ben — when smoke prompts run, include these checks: 1) safety filter pass rate 2) few-shot regression on 50 eval prompts 3) output length distribution sanity 4) KV cache correctness (chat traces)
ben: got it. will run smoke harness and paste results here.
akira: rollback plan note: if we hit >1.5x token cost or >1.2x latency p95 vs prod baseline, rollback immediately. also revert catalog alias mapping; I can handle alias swap.
matt: also double-check embedding endpoint parity (we use a lite-opt path). If embeddings drift >0.03 cosine on sample set, rollback.
ben: code PR for the catalog pin is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/4821 — needs another review on the alias swap logic.
marie: @matt can you take a quick look at PR #4821? small change in catalog pin flow.
matt: on it, will review before 09:45 PT.
diane: ops FYI — logging retention for this run should be 72h and traces captured for the first 500 sessions.
ben: smoke run results (staging) — safety pass 98%, p95 latency +8% vs baseline (within threshold), token cost +4%, embeddings cosine drift 0.012. KV traces looked fine. Attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/ben/zetta-smoke-0918
akira: looks safe to promote to prod pin window. I'm ready for alias swap at 11:30 PT.
marie: prod pin window scheduled 11:30–12:00 PT. who will be primary deploy?
ben: I will do the prod pin, akira will be backup and handle rollback if needed.
matt: LGTM on PR, left 1 tiny comment.
marie: final checklist before prod pin: - PR merged - reserve prod slot (diane) - prometheus alerts enabled for p95/cost drift - ops oncall notified (akira) - rollback playbook at hand
diane: reserving prod-slot-9 for 11:15 PT to prepare. reservation id rsv-7382.
deploy-bot: dry-run alias swap check OK for zetta-4b:v2 — no conflicts detected.
ben: merging PR now. merging... done.
marie: great. small note for post-deploy: run the regression eval set (200 prompts) and post summary here within 20m.
akira: copying rollback commands here for quick paste:
```
# rollback alias swap
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CATALOG_TOKEN" \
  https://catalog.redwood/api/v1/aliases/swap \
  -d '{"alias":"zetta-4b","version":"v1"}'
```
ben: prod pin started 11:30 PT. doing alias swap now.
deploy-bot: alias swap event logged: evt-9912, swapped zetta-4b -> zetta-4b:v2, rollout 100%.
ben: post-pin quick checks: p95 +6%, token cost +3.5%, safety pass 97.5%, embeddings drift 0.015. Everything within agreed thresholds.
marie: excellent — leaving pin for 24h observation. thanks everyone :tada:
akira: I'll keep monitoring for the 24h window, will call rollback if anything exceeds thresholds.
matt: nice work team.
marie: closing thread once 24h window completes and no regressions.
